20: The harsh condemnation for a person to worship Allah by the grave of a righteous person and even worse than that would be to worship the one in a grave
21: The chapter of what is narrated that, exceeding proper limits in the Graves of the righteous causes it be something that is worshipped other than Alllah
22: The chapter of what comes with regards to the safeguarding of Al-mustafa (the one who is selected) towards all the sides of tawhid and that he blocked every pathway leading to shirk
23: The chapter of what is narrated, That some of this ummah will worship الأوثان (Anything that is worshipped other than Allah)
